owner.title: Server Owner Survey
owner.description: Help us understand what server owners need. Takes ~5 minutes.

thankYou.title: Thanks for helping us understand what server owners need!
thankYou.description: Your answers will directly shape the tools we build. Leave your Discord username if you'd like to be notified when results are published.

screenOut.title: Thanks for your interest!
screenOut.description: This survey is for people who run or manage a Hytale server.

discovery_pain.title: Discovery & Challenges
discovery_pain.description: Where are you listed and what's hard?

feature_prioritization.title: Features & Analytics
feature_prioritization.description: What would make you list on a new directory?

reviews_trust.title: Reviews & Trust
reviews_trust.description: How do you feel about player reviews?

q1.title: What is your role?
q1.subtitle: This survey is for server owners and admins

options.not_managing: I don't run or manage a server

q2.title: How long has your Hytale server been running?

q3.title: What is your server's average daily player count?

q4.title: What is your primary game mode?

q5.title: What hosting provider do you use?
q5.subtitle: This helps us understand the hosting landscape

q6.title: How much do you spend monthly on your server?
q6.subtitle: Including hosting, plugins, etc. (USD)

q7.title: Where is your server currently listed?
q7.subtitle: Select all that apply

q8.title: How satisfied are you with your current server listing platform(s)?

q9.title: What are your TOP 3 biggest challenges in growing your server?
q9.subtitle: Select exactly 3

options.getting_new_players: Getting new players to find my server
options.keeping_players: Keeping players coming back after they join
options.competing_paid: Competing with servers that buy votes or pay for top spots
options.figuring_wants: Figuring out what players actually want

q10.title: What is the most annoying part of listing or advertising your server on directories?
q10.subtitle: Pick the one that bothers you most

options.creating_banners: Creating banners, images, or promotional graphics
options.vote_rewards: Setting up vote rewards (Votifier, vote links, etc.)
options.multiple_sites: Listing on multiple sites with different requirements
options.keeping_updated: Keeping information up-to-date across all platforms
options.initial_visibility: Getting initial visibility before anyone knows about my server
options.not_listed: I'm not listed anywhere, so I haven't experienced this

q11.title: Imagine a new directory automatically found your server from your existing listings and created a listing for you. How would you feel?
q11.subtitle: This would pull info from sites like HytaleTop100, HyServers, etc.

options.love_it: Love it — one less site I have to manually set up
options.great_can_edit: Great, as long as I can claim and edit it afterward
options.approve_first: OK, but I'd want to approve it before it goes live
options.rather_myself: I'd rather add my server myself
options.not_listed_elsewhere: I'm not listed anywhere else, so this doesn't apply to me

q12.title: Pick your TOP 3 most important features in a server directory:
q12.subtitle: Select exactly 3

options.fair_ranking: Fair ranking that doesn't favor big/paying servers
options.detailed_analytics: Detailed analytics (who visits, where they come from)
options.player_reviews: Player reviews visible on my listing
options.respond_reviews: Ability to respond to player reviews publicly
options.discord_notifications: Discord notifications (new review alerts, server status updates)
options.easy_claiming: Easy server claiming and verified owner badge
options.auto_imported: Auto-imported listing from other directories (zero setup)

q13.title: You have 10 tokens to spend on what info matters most to you.
q13.subtitle: Tap to assign tokens — more tokens = more important to you

options.traffic_sources: Where your players come from (which sites, searches, or links bring people to your listing)
options.listing_conversion: How well your listing converts (how many people see it vs. how many actually click to join)
options.player_retention: Whether players stick around (how many come back after their first time on your server)
options.review_themes: What players say about you (common themes from reviews — what people love and what they complain about)
options.competitor_comparison: How you compare to similar servers (see your stats next to servers in your same category)
options.promotion_tracking: Track which promotions work (custom links for Discord/Reddit/TikTok so you know which posts actually bring players)

q14.title: If those basic stats were free, which extras would make you consider paying a small monthly fee?
q14.subtitle: Pick up to 2

options.player_retention: See if players come back after joining (and when they stop)
options.review_themes: See what players say about my server (review themes and trends)
options.tracking_links: Custom tracking links to measure my promotions (Discord posts, Reddit, TikTok)
options.alerts: Get alerts when my rating drops or traffic spikes
options.export_data: Export my data to a spreadsheet
options.compare_servers: Compare my stats to similar servers
options.none: None — the free basics are enough for me

q14b.title: If those extra features cost a monthly fee, what would feel fair? (USD)

options.free_trial: I'd only try it if there was a free trial first
options.depends: Depends on how much it actually helps me grow

q15.title: How would you feel about player reviews on your server listing?

options.great_feedback: Great — honest feedback helps me improve
options.fine_respond: Fine, but I want to be able to respond to reviews
options.prefer_votes: I'd prefer no reviews — just votes

q16.title: If a content creator (YouTuber/TikToker) offered to review your server, would you...

options.welcome_know: Welcome it, but want to know beforehand
options.see_before: Only if I can see the review before it's published

q17.title: What review format would give you the most useful feedback as an owner?
q17.subtitle: This helps us design the review system

options.binary_steam: Thumbs up / Thumbs down with a text comment, shown as an aggregate label (Steam style — e.g., "Very Positive", "Mixed")
options.stars_amazon: 1–5 star rating with a text comment (Amazon/Google style)
options.multi_criteria: Rate specific aspects separately — community, performance, content, fairness
options.no_reviews: I don't want reviews on my listing

q18.title: What ONE thing would make you immediately list your server on a new directory?
q18.subtitle: Tell us in your own words

q19.title: What country are you based in?

q_feedback_rating.title: How was your experience taking this survey?
q_feedback_rating.subtitle: 1 = terrible, 5 = great

q_feedback_text.subtitle: What would you change, add, or remove?
